rows.title: EnergyPlus version object
rows.required: a Version object matching the pinned engine
rows.why_it_matters: The engine must know which IDD the input targets; a missing version object risks silent misinterpretation of fields.

rows.title: Simulation timestep
rows.why_it_matters: Coarse timesteps can miss peak temperatures and distort exceedance hour counts.

rows.title: Run period
rows.why_it_matters: Criteria are assessed over the year/summer.

rows.title: Zones
rows.why_it_matters: Every assessed space must be a zone.

rows.title: Bedroom detection
rows.required: at least one bedroom for TM59 criteria (b)/(2026 b)
rows.why_it_matters: The sleep-related criteria cannot be assessed without a bedroom.

rows.title: Occupancy
rows.required: People objects in every assessed zone

rows.title: Operable window openings
rows.required: opening objects for the natural-ventilation route
rows.why_it_matters: Without operable openings the home is effectively the mechanical route (fixed-temperature criteria apply).
rows.how_to_fix: Add AirflowNetwork or ZoneVentilation objects, or assess via the mechanical route.

rows.title: Output:Variable 'zone mean radiant temperature'
rows.why_it_matters: Required: MRT for operative-temperature derivation. OverheatLens derives operative temperature as 0.5*(MAT+MRT) (low air speed), labelled as a derived metric.
rows.how_to_fix: Add 'Output:Variable, *, Zone Mean Air Temperature, hourly;' (and MRT).

rows.title: EnergyPlus version object
rows.why_it_matters: A version mismatch may require transitioning the file before use.
rows.how_to_fix: Run the EnergyPlus Preprocessor 'IDFVersionUpdater' if needed.

rows.title: Simulation timestep
rows.why_it_matters: Coarse timesteps can miss peak temperatures and distort exceedance hour counts.

rows.title: Run period
rows.why_it_matters: Criteria are assessed over the year/summer.

rows.title: Zones
rows.why_it_matters: Every assessed space must be a zone.

rows.title: Occupancy
rows.required: People objects in every assessed zone

rows.title: Infiltration
rows.required: infiltration per zone (TM59 default 0.3–0.5 ach as applicable)
rows.why_it_matters: Infiltration materially affects night cooling and exceedance hours.
rows.how_to_fix: Add ZoneInfiltration:* objects per the methodology defaults.

rows.title: Operable window openings
rows.required: opening objects enabling the required window-control strategy
rows.why_it_matters: Overheating criteria assume occupant window control.

rows.title: Window-control strategy conformance
rows.detected: window control found — verify against the applicable rule
rows.required: TM59:2017 §3.3: open when internal dry bulb > 22 °C and room occupied
rows.why_it_matters: The criteria assume specific opening behaviour; non-conforming control invalidates the assessment.

rows.title: Mechanical cooling
rows.why_it_matters: Cooling changes the applicable criteria (TM59:2026 criterion c; TM59:2017 §4.3 fixed method).
rows.how_to_fix: Select the mechanical route for assessment.
